name: zalora-mcp
description: Zalora (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool

platform_mcp_zalora_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALORA_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_zalora_client_id.description: Application ID of an OAuth application created in ZALORA Seller Center (Settings > Integration Management > OAuth Applications > Add Application).

platform_mcp_zalora_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALORA_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_zalora_client_secret.description: Application Secret of the same application; sent with the id as HTTP Basic to /oauth/client-credentials (grant_type=client_credentials) for a 1-hour bearer token.

platform_mcp_zalora_country.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALORA_COUNTRY
platform_mcp_zalora_country.description: Country code of the price row that update_listing / end_listing change (Seller Center country code of the venture, as used in PUT /v2/product/{productId}/prices/{country}).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/seller-settings: the authenticated seller's settings, used as the credential check.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PUT /v2/product/{productId}/prices/{country} {price} merge-patches the LIVE list (regular) price of one variation for the configured country; an existing sale price is kept (salePrice omitted). `listing_id` is the numeric variation productId (GET /v2/product-set/{productSetId}/products). Returns the stored row with status active|inactive and any warnings.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PUT /v2/stock/product [{productId, quantity}] synchronously sets the stock of one variation (`listing_id` = numeric productId, required). Products fulfilled by the venture cannot be updated; ignored products are listed in the response.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: PUT /v2/product/{productId}/prices/{country}/status {status: inactive} stops selling the variation in the configured country (reversible with active). Only meaningful for multi-country sellers: single-country (LSC) setups reject inactive with 422.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /v2/orders?limit&offset (both required, sent from limit/page)&section&dateStart, newest first. `status` selects the section filter (status_pending, status_shipped, status_delivered, status_failed, status_canceled, status_pending_all, …); per-item statuses are in raw.statusList / raw.items[].status. raw.number is the customer-facing order number and raw.orderItemIds are needed for status changes.
